units.source_text: 父亲和住持对军部和官僚只重视神社而轻视寺庙——岂止轻视，甚至压迫——十分愤慨，

en.t: My father and the chief priest were deeply indignant that the military and the bureaucrats valued only the shrines while slighting the temples -- not merely slighting them, but even oppressing them --

units.source_text: 议论了今后如何经营寺庙的问题。

en.t: and they discussed the question of how temples should be managed from then on.
